Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Create an Ansible playbook that installs Docker (apt or yum source), adds a specified user to the docker group, and ensures the docker daemon is running and enabled at boot.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.

- name: Install and configure Docker
  hosts: all
  become: true
  vars:
    docker_user: "{{ docker_user | default(omit) }}"

  pre_tasks:
    - name: Ensure docker_user variable is defined
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - docker_user is defined
          - docker_user | length > 0
        fail_msg: "Set 'docker_user' variable to the username to add to the docker group."

    - name: Verify the specified docker_user exists
      ansible.builtin.getent:
        database: passwd
        key: "{{ docker_user }}"
      register: user_getent

    - name: Fail if user does not exist
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - user_getent.found
        fail_msg: "User {{ docker_user }} does not exist on the target host."

  tasks:
    - name: Remove old Docker packages on Debian/Ubuntu
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name:
          - docker
          - docker-engine
          - docker.io
          - containerd
          - runc
        state: absent
        purge: yes
      when: ansible_facts.os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Install prerequisites on Debian/Ubuntu
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name:
          - ca-certificates
          - curl
          - gnupg
          - lsb-release
        state: present
        update_cache: yes
      when: ansible_facts.os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Ensure APT keyrings directory exists
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /etc/apt/keyrings
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'
      when: ansible_facts.os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Download Docker GPG key (ASCII) for Debian/Ubuntu
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: https://download.docker.com/linux/{{ (ansible_facts.distribution | lower == 'ubuntu') | ternary('ubuntu', 'debian') }}/gpg
        dest: /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc
        mode: '0644'
      when: ansible_facts.os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Convert Docker GPG key to dearmored format
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc
        creates: /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg
      when: ansible_facts.os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Set permissions on Docker GPG key
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg
        mode: '0644'
      when: ansible_facts.os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Determine APT architecture mapping
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        docker_apt_arch: >-
          {{ 'amd64' if ansible_facts.architecture in ['x86_64'] else
             'arm64' if ansible_facts.architecture in ['aarch64','arm64'] else
             'armhf' if ansible_facts.architecture in ['armv7l','armv6l'] else
             ansible_facts.architecture }}
      when: ansible_facts.os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Add Docker APT repository
      ansible.builtin.apt_repository:
        repo: >-
          deb [arch={{ docker_apt_arch }} signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg]
          https://download.docker.com/linux/{{ (ansible_facts.distribution | lower == 'ubuntu') | ternary('ubuntu', 'debian') }}
          {{ ansible_facts.distribution_release | lower }} stable
        filename: docker
        state: present
      when: ansible_facts.os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Update APT cache after adding Docker repo
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        update_cache: yes
      when: ansible_facts.os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Install Docker packages on Debian/Ubuntu
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name:
          - docker-ce
          - docker-ce-cli
          - containerd.io
          - docker-buildx-plugin
          - docker-compose-plugin
        state: present
      when: ansible_facts.os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Remove old Docker packages on RHEL/CentOS/Rocky/Alma
      ansible.builtin.yum:
        name:
          - docker
          - docker-client
          - docker-client-latest
          - docker-common
          - docker-latest
          - docker-latest-logrotate
          - docker-logrotate
          - docker-engine
        state: absent
      when: ansible_facts.os_family == "RedHat"

    - name: Install prerequisites on RHEL/CentOS/Rocky/Alma
      ansible.builtin.yum:
        name:
          - yum-utils
          - device-mapper-persistent-data
          - lvm2
          - ca-certificates
          - curl
        state: present
      when: ansible_facts.os_family == "RedHat"

    - name: Add Docker YUM repository
      ansible.builtin.yum_repository:
        name: docker-ce-stable
        description: Docker CE Stable - $basearch
        baseurl: https://download.docker.com/linux/centos/$releasever/$basearch/stable
        enabled: yes
        gpgcheck: yes
        gpgkey: https://download.docker.com/linux/centos/gpg
      when: ansible_facts.os_family == "RedHat"

    - name: Make cache after adding Docker repo
      ansible.builtin.yum:
        name: "*"
        state: latest
        update_cache: yes
      when: ansible_facts.os_family == "RedHat"

    - name: Install Docker packages on RHEL/CentOS/Rocky/Alma
      ansible.builtin.yum:
        name:
          - docker-ce
          - docker-ce-cli
          - containerd.io
          - docker-buildx-plugin
          - docker-compose-plugin
        state: present
      when: ansible_facts.os_family == "RedHat"

    - name: Ensure docker group exists
      ansible.builtin.group:
        name: docker
        state: present

    - name: Add specified user to docker group
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: "{{ docker_user }}"
        groups: docker
        append: yes

    - name: Ensure Docker service is enabled and running
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: docker
        state: started
        enabled: yes
